sources.title: A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market
sources.source_type: Original working paper and author-hosted full text
sources.access_depth: Full author-hosted PDF inspected, sections2.1 and4, printed pages9-17; SSRN metadata and authors pages verified. PDF header says first version2024-02-16; do not assume exact identity with SSRN revised version.
sources.short_quote: Trade the stocks with the top 20 Relative Volume.
sources.evidence_summary: Historical five-minute opening-range breakout improves when selecting unusually active stocks using volume measured only during the completed opening range. Study reports2016-2023 top20 stocks-in-play return1637% with commission; this is an author backtest claim, not observed client account growth.
sources.sample: More than7000 US stocks,2016-01-01 to2023-12-31; authors use CRSP stock universe including delisted stocks and IQFeed intraday raw bars.

paper_rules.universe_filters: Opening price>$5, mean previous14 daily volume>=1million shares, previous14-day ATR>$0.50.
paper_rules.relative_volume: Current first5-minute volume / mean first5-minute volume of previous14 sessions; require>=1.0 and rank descending, choose top20. This is time-matched volume, NOT completed full-day volume.
paper_rules.direction_and_entry: If first5-minute close>open, buy stop at first5-minute high; if close<open, sell stop at first5-minute low; doji skips. Orders only after range is complete.
paper_rules.exit: Stop at10% of daily ATR from executed entry; otherwise exit16:00.
paper_rules.paper_capital_and_risk: Initial$25000, long+short, maximum4x leverage; text sizes each position for1% loss of capital allocated to that position if stopped. Exact simultaneous portfolio risk budgeting needs reproduction.
paper_rules.news: Stocks-in-play discussion motivates company news, but operational filter is opening relative volume; paper does not itself supply a verified event-timestamp news filter.

costs_and_biases: Explicit commission is$0.0035/share; no separate bid/ask spread, stop-gap slippage, borrow/locate fee stress was verified in the inspected methodological sections.
Relative-volume and time-frame alternatives were explored on the same historical period; no independent future client validation demonstrated.
Author claims survivorship-aware CRSP data; our current-directory universe is weaker and cannot inherit that property.

Relative volume formula in extracted PDF has an apparent repeated t-1 index under summation; prose clearly describes averaging previous14 opening ranges. Source implementation should be checked before claiming exact replication.
s500_constraints: Cannot scale$25000 long-short/4x/top20 results to$500 cash whole-share account.
Our first test should be separately named long-only, no leverage, one affordable stock, with full cash/quote/settlement checks; changing portfolio means a new strategy variant.
No option return can be inferred from stock ORB performance.
codable_research_variant_not_run: At09:35 calculate opening-range RV against same clock interval in prior14sessions; price/ATR/liquidity filters as source.
Separate long-only highest-RV affordable candidate; entry only after completed range breaks upward, avoid looking at later day high when selecting.
Use one-minute bars only as first approximation; if entry/stop order is ambiguous within one bar, record conservative execution or unresolved result, never assume favorable order.
Include full spread/slippage scenarios and end-of-day exit; test signal and event-news subset separately, with announcement known before09:35.
missing_inputs: YTD per-symbol first5-minute and later intraday bars with at least14-session warmup
Historical exact same-interval volume, not full-day totals
Historical corporate identity/universe and split actions
Executable bid/ask, stop trigger timing and halt/auction evidence
Timestamped company news/earnings releases for any added event filter

sources.title: Market Intraday Momentum
sources.revision_date_on_ssrn: 2017-06-20 (page header; version listing also displays later metadata)
sources.access_depth: Original SSRN metadata and abstract read; full methodological cost tables not inspected.
sources.short_quote: the first half-hour return on the market since the previous day’s market close predicts the last half-hour return
sources.evidence_summary: SPY1993-2013 historical intraday evidence links previous close-to10:00 return with15:30-16:00 return. Reported predictability is stronger on high-volume, volatile and major macro-news days, and appears in10other ETFs.
sources.sample: S&P500 ETF high-frequency data1993-2013;10other actively traded domestic/international ETFs mentioned.

paper_rules.predictor: First-half-hour return measured from PREVIOUS CLOSE to10:00, includes overnight gap.
paper_rules.conditions: Abstract says stronger for higher-volume/volatility/recession/macro-news days; numerical cutoffs not confirmed from full text.

costs_and_biases: Exact execution, net-cost assumptions and out-of-sample implementation not verified from abstract, so do not reproduce numerical profitability.
ETF-level relationship cannot automatically transfer to individual stocks or0DTE contracts.
1993-2013 market structure may not persist in2026; current research must account for altered spreads and competition.
s500_constraints: SPY/QQQ whole-share affordability must be checked; do not substitute options or leveredETF without a separate model.
A long-only cash variant cannot be called a replication of symmetric long-short timing.
codable_research_variant_not_run: Use completed10:00 return since prior close as a frozen predictor; observe eligible ETF15:30-16:00 return.
For first diagnostic, estimate conditional returns/sign agreement, then separately simulate long-only when predictor positive, with realistic15:30quotes and16:00exit.
Predefine high-volume relative to same-clock historical volume using only information before entry; choose a cutoff before looking at new outcomes.
missing_inputs: Full source-paper execution and cost details

sources.title: Implications of Transaction Costs for the Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift
sources.source_type: Original authors working-paper abstract plus university bibliographic record of journal article
sources.access_depth: Original SSRN abstract and LBS bibliographic record read. LBS explicitly has no full text; exact sample dates and numeric cost schedule were not independently verified.
sources.short_quote: profits of implementing the PEAD trading strategy are significantly reduced by transaction costs
sources.evidence_summary: Bigger apparent post-earnings drift is associated with higher trading costs, and implementing PEAD loses substantial profit to these costs. This is useful counter-evidence against chasing small illiquid stocks solely because their gross drift looks larger.
sources.sample: Empirical portfolio and regression study; exact sample dates not verified in accessible abstract.

paper_rules.verified: Examines earnings-surprise response, later drift and transaction-cost differences.
paper_rules.not_verified: Exact SUE construction, portfolio cutoff, holding window and original cost levels cannot be claimed from abstract.

costs_and_biases: Apparent gross anomaly can reflect a return difficult to capture after spread/impact costs.
Do not import published net returns or thresholds without the full methods.
s500_constraints: Small account does not remove wide percentage spreads; minimum fees and integer-share constraints may be material.
Long-only affordable variant omits short leg and differs from research portfolios.
codable_research_variant_not_run: For any proposed earnings-continuation test, record announcement timestamp and as-of analyst consensus, then stratify results by pre-entry spread/liquidity.
Compare gross and fully costed returns on identical event selections; additionally retain continuous$500 sizing effects separately.
Treat these as our validation controls motivated by the paper, not as an exact source trading algorithm.
missing_inputs: Announcement publication time and first eligible tradable entry
Spread/quote history and liquidity before signal
Full source methods for exact replication

sources.title: PEAD.txt: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift Using Text
sources.source_type: Original Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia working paper21-07 full PDF
sources.access_depth: Full original PDF inspected, data/method and strategy sections, printed pages6-12.
sources.short_quote: using only information from the past eight quarters as the training set
sources.evidence_summary: Earnings-call text surprise predicts subsequent abnormal returns beyond the headline EPS number. Paper fits regularized text model using earlier8quarters and generates predictions for the next quarter; textual surprise uses management presentation and Q&A separately.
sources.sample: Initial108704 observations2008Q1-2019Q4; final85160observations2010Q1-2019Q4 covering4701firms. CapitalIQ transcripts plusCRSP/Compustat/IBES.

paper_rules.features: log(1+term frequency),1000unigrams+1000bigrams for presentation and Q&A separately:4000features; vocabulary selected from training data.
paper_rules.training: Regularized logistic model of call text vs one-day abnormal-return categories; rolling previous8quarters, next-quarter predictions; avoid mixing our observed2026 outcomes into training.
paper_rules.signal: SUE.txt=log-odds(high abnormal return)-log-odds(low abnormal return). Quintile cutoffs use training-set scores.
paper_rules.portfolio: Equal-weight long top estimated quintile/short bottom quintile; enter first close after earnings call, hold63trading days. Paper also examines32days.
paper_rules.result_context: Reported text spread CAR2.87% over63days and daily factor alpha3.9bps for63-day portfolio are research statistics, not our net$500return.

costs_and_biases: No bid/ask/borrow/commission implementation was verified in inspected portfolio section; never call source alpha after-realistic-cost profit.
Paper has chronological out-of-sample model predictions internally, but that is neither live trading evidence nor unseen2026validation for our project.
Transcripts must be available before entry; event-day close entry can be impossible when transcript publication comes later.
Vendor coverage and long-short quintile construction may not carry to small cash portfolio.
s500_constraints: Equal-weight long-short many names is not feasible to copy mechanically with$500and integer shares.
A long-only1name32/63day variant would tie up capital and needs its own validation.
Reading summaries with anLLM is not equivalent to fitting the paper’s rolling text model.
codable_research_variant_not_run: First create event table with release/call/transcript publication timestamps, EPS/revenue surprises and explicit guidance changes.
For a faithful model, train only prior8quarters using then-available text, fix vocabulary/cutoffs, generate next-quarter scores, and delay entry until actual transcript availability.

As a simpler separately named hypothesis, classify explicit upward guidance plus revenue/EPS beat from timestamped primary releases and measure subsequent1/5/10/20session returns; these horizons are our proposal, not source-validated rules.
missing_inputs: Historical transcripts with publication timestamps and sections
At least2years of earlier training data for full replication
Point-in-time earnings/consensus and matched benchmark data
Security identity/delisting returns and executable costs

priority: ORB with same-time opening relative volume is the closest clearly specified new intraday hypothesis; unlike previous daily-volume models.
Timestamped earnings/guidance continuation is a second direction; cost study provides an explicit execution check, and text paper supports going beyond headline EPS.
Market late-day timing is a lower-priority distinct ETF control, not a0DTE shortcut.
source_access_limits: SSRN directPDF link for ORB returned abstractHTML; full paper was instead read from the author’s public website.
Google returnedJS shell and Bing degraded to first-word results; DuckDuckGo was used only for discovery and claims were checked on original author/institution pages.
No complete articles or PDFs are included in this evidence package; full PDF research copies remain local temporary files.
No live trades, new backtests or communications were executed.
